title: OMA project state
description: Single source of truth for an OMA-managed project. Lives at .oma/state.json. Only OMA skills write it; agents and users read it.

mode.description: Absent or 'greenfield' = a new project. 'brownfield' = OMA was pointed at an existing codebase; the archaeology phase runs first and the default stack profile is ignored.

brownfield.description: Present only when mode is 'brownfield'. Written at init and by the archaeology phase.

scope.description: extend = add a feature, existing contracts read-only; refactor = improve structure with behavior frozen, the test suite is the contract; audit = read-only, produces findings and a backlog, no source changes.

baseline.description: The green/red verdict the archaeologist recorded before any change. null until 00-archaeology runs.

profile.description: Name of a profile in the plugin's stacks/ directory, or 'custom'.

overrides.description: User-requested deviations from the profile, e.g. {"db": "sqlite"}.

resolved.description: Path to the authored stack.md once Architecture has run.

by.description: Absent or 'user' = the user decided this gate. 'auto' = an unattended /oma:auto run approved it against the checklist in the auto skill. Never write 'user' for a gate the user did not see.

contracts.description: Keys: stack, data_model (frozen at the Architecture gate); api, tokens, motion (frozen at the Design gate). Each freezes at the gate of the phase that authored it — except api, which is authored at Architecture but freezes at Design so UX can still bend it.

security.description: Written by the orchestrator from oma-security's review in the DevOps phase.

open_findings.description: critical + high still unfixed. Non-zero at the DevOps gate means the user is explicitly accepting them.

auto.description: Present once /oma:auto has been started. The policy is the user's standing answer to the decisions they would otherwise have made at gates, captured before the run and never changed mid-run.

run.description: Nth unattended run on this project; names the journal file.

status.description: 'halted' means a stop condition fired and the user's input is needed; work already on disk is intact and every approved phase is committed.

stop_after.description: Phase id after whose gate the run ends. Normally 08-ship.

journal.description: Path to the run report, written after every phase — the run's memory, since the orchestrator's context will not survive eight phases.

assumptions.description: Count of decisions taken without the user. Every one is listed in the journal with how to reverse it.

ship.description: Written at 08-ship. Its presence means a ship report exists for the tree as it stood at that moment.

final_check.description: Pipeline verdicts from the ship-time run — not copied from an earlier QA report.

handoff_seq.description: Sequence number of the most recent handoff record. Orchestrator-owned.
